Stream handles crawl of 5+ pages with multiple events

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, crawl_stream, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_depth=1, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = crawl_stream(engine, url)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
